EVM EnBound Powerbank 10000mAh – Compact Power, Smart Convenience

The EVM EnBound Powerbank 10000mAh is designed for users who need reliable power on the go without carrying bulky accessories. Built with a high-capacity 10000mAh polymer battery, this power bank delivers stable, efficient, and safe charging for smartphones, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices. Its pocket friendly compact size makes it an ideal everyday companion for travel, office, outdoor use, and emergencies.

Unlike ordinary power banks, the EVM EnBound model comes with three built-in output cables, eliminating the need to carry extra charging wires. Whether you use Android, iPhone, or other compatible devices, this all-in-one solution ensures hassle-free charging anytime, anywhere. Combined with fast charging support, it helps you power up your devices quickly and efficiently when time matters most.

High-Capacity 10000mAh Polymer Battery for Reliable Performance

The advanced high-capacity 10000mAh polymer battery offers better energy density, improved safety, and longer life compared to standard batteries. It provides multiple charges for most smartphones while maintaining consistent output performance. This makes the EVM EnBound Powerbank 10000mAh suitable for daily commuters, business professionals, students, and frequent travelers.

Fast Charging with Smart Power Management

Equipped with intelligent power management, this power bank supports fast charging to reduce downtime and keep your devices ready when you need them. The optimized charging speed ensures efficient energy transfer while protecting your devices from overcharging, overheating, and short circuits.

Three Built-in Output Cables – No Extra Accessories Needed

One of the standout features of the EVM EnBound Powerbank 10000mAh is its three built-in output cables. This integrated design allows you to charge multiple device types without searching for compatible cables. It is a practical solution for users who prefer convenience, portability, and minimal clutter.

Suction Cup Phone Holder for Hands-Free Charging

The innovative suction cup phone holder adds an extra layer of usability. You can securely attach your phone to the while charging, making it ideal for video calls, navigation, or media viewing. This feature enhances user comfort and sets the apart from conventional power banks.

Pocket Friendly Compact Size with Premium Build

Designed with portability in mind, the pocket friendly compact size ensures easy storage in your pocket, backpack, or handbag. Despite its compact form factor, the maintains a sturdy and premium build quality suitable for everyday use and travel.

24 Months Brand Warranty for Peace of Mind

Backed by a 24 months brand warranty, the EVM EnBound delivers long-term reliability and customer confidence. The warranty reflects the brand’s commitment to quality, durability, and after-sales support, making it a dependable investment for personal or professional use.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Product: EVM EnBound Powerbank 10000mAh
  • Battery Type: High-capacity 10000mAh polymer battery
  • Charging: Fast charging support with smart protection
  • Cables: Three built-in output cables for multiple devices
  • Additional Feature: Suction cup phone holder for hands-free use
  • Design: Pocket friendly compact size, lightweight and portable

If you are looking for a reliable, compact, and feature-rich power bank, the is a smart choice. With fast charging, built-in cables, a suction cup phone holder, and a durable polymer battery, it delivers convenience, performance, and long-term value in one compact device.
